messages:
Avery (CSM): Quick kickoff note for Vireo Labs onboarding — looped Priya and team. Primary objectives: integrate chat API, validate embeddings workflow, and lock pilot SLOs.
Priya (Vireo PM): Thanks! We're excited. High-level timeline request: a 4-week pilot window, with mid-pilot review at week 2.
Avery (CSM): Proposed condensed plan:
- Week 0 (pre): billing + API keys, KMS handshake, account access
- Week 1: basic integration + smoke tests (chat + embeddings)
- Week 2: load/perf tests + batching tuning
- Week 3: pilot run + user feedback collection
- Week 4: wrap, metrics review, and renewal-readiness checklist
Nikhil (Solutions Eng): I'll pair on integration. Need a sample of the expected prompt patterns and embedding dims. Priya, can you share a short sample payload?
Priya (Vireo PM): Pushed a tiny sample to the shared drive: /shared/vireo/sample_prompts.json (view only). Embedding vector = 1536 dims. Typical prompt length ~120 tokens.
Zoe (Enablement): I'll prepare a 20-minute intro for your PMs/designers: how to interpret latency/cost dashboards, and a short playbook for fallback strategies.
Liam (CS Ops): Heads-up: if you expect bursty traffic (>150 r/s) we'll recommend configuring a short autoscale buffer and a cost guardrail. I can set up an alert for >$750/day burn.
onboarding-bot: Meeting created: "Vireo onboarding — week 0 sync" Thu 9am PT. Agenda: access, security, sample data, next steps.
Avery (CSM): Risk flag: renewal window is Month 8. Let's include a quick business metrics map so we can show value at month 4. Priya, who owns adoption metrics on your side?
Priya (Vireo PM): That's me. I'll draft 3 KPIs: weekly active users touching the feature, avg session prompt tokens, and conversion lift on search.
Sunita (Vireo Security): We'll need to validate KMS and ensure logs are routed to our SIEM. Can we get the KMS integration docs before the security review?
Nikhil (Solutions Eng): I'll paste the KMS steps into the repo and tag Sunita. Also will add a template for load test commands and a quick curl example for embeddings calls.
Avery (CSM): Success criteria for pilot we propose: 1) p95 <400ms for typical prompt mix, 2) embeddings cosine drift <0.02 vs baseline, 3) no P0 incidents during pilot. If those hold we schedule optimization cycles and a renewal prep call at Month 6.
Zoe (Enablement): I'll run a short onboarding lab (30m) for engineers post-integration. Can do recordings and a one-pager.
Priya (Vireo PM): Sounds good. One blocker: our legal team needs a DPA addendum. I'll get that to you by EOD.
Liam (CS Ops): I'll provision a sandbox Key and a read-only dashboard for Vireo testers.
Avery (CSM): Action items: Priya share DPA + confirm sample payload by EOD; Sunita review KMS doc before Thu; Nikhil to add load test snippets; Zoe to prep enablement lab. I'll post weekly health updates in this thread. React with :white_check_mark: when you've taken your action.
Priya (Vireo PM): ✅ will do.
Nikhil (Solutions Eng): ✅ adding snippets now.
Sunita (Vireo Security): ✅ KMS first pass by Wed.
Zoe (Enablement): ✅ recording planned after integration.
Avery (CSM): Thanks team — see you on Thu.
